milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the cobblestone wall corridor (centered at spawn-relative [0, 1, 6]) and face toward it. The corridor spans X=[-3,3], Y=[0,3], Z=[4,8], so the center is approximately (0, 1, 6). max_distance=8 allows detection as the player approaches the corridor entrance. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the walls.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the red sandstone stairs (centered at spawn-relative [0, 1, 11]) and face toward them. The stairs span X=[-1,1], Y=[0,2], Z=[10,12], so the center is approximately (0, 1, 11). max_distance=8 allows detection once the player has passed through the corridor and is approaching the stairs. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the staircase.
